inlines.v: SUPERINTEND'ENT, noun One who has the oversight and charge of something, with the power of direction; as the superintendent of an alms-house or work-house; the superintendent of public works; the superintendent of customs or finance. 1. An ecclesiastical superior in some reformed churches.
